info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Account Management API
info.description: The Investment Account Management API enables businesses to update and manage existing investment accounts efficiently. This endpoint allows users to modify account details, including preferences and configurations, ensuring they align with the client's financial strategies. Financial institutions, portfolio managers, and account administrators typically rely on this API to maintain accurate investment data and enhance client services. By facilitating real-time updates, this API supports seamless adjustments to investment strategies as market conditions change.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an investment account identified by the account number. You can modify various aspects of the account to reflect the latest information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of an existing investment account identified by the specified account number (ACC-200045). Provide the necessary fields in the JSON format corresponding to the parameters that need to be updated.

200.description: The request was successful, and the investment account has been updated.
